observations: A vintage-style treadle sewing machine is shown on a wooden table with a metal frame.
The machine has a black body with yellow decorative patterns and text.
The needle and presser foot are visible, and the handwheel is present on the right side.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some wear and scuff marks on the body and table.
The table has a reddish-brown finish and a metal wire footstool underneath.
The background shows a cluttered indoor space with fabrics and other items.

claims.claim: In good condition working perfectly fine
claims.evidence: No photo shows the machine in operation. No proof of functionality is provided.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the machine being operated, including the handwheel turning and the needle moving up and down.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal mechanical issues or missing parts.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the internal gears, belt, and needle mechanism in motion.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or requiring repair

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential components like the bobbin case, shuttle, or power cord.
risks.proof: A photo showing all parts laid out, including the bobbin case, shuttle, and any included accessories.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation, showing the handwheel turning and needle moving.
Close-up photo or video of the internal gears and needle mechanism.
Photo showing all parts included (bobbin case, shuttle, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
